scope: Read-only analysis of uploaded mint-log.json; no site requests, tests, APK or repository changes.
source: mint-log.json and original user popup capture (private files, not published)
limitations: Initial capture events before662 were overwritten by the500-event cap.
All43 retained API events containing a stack have the same shared Axios/Fy/request transport stack; it ends before the component caller.
nearbyRequests/recentRequests explicitly have correlationOnly=true and are not proof of popup causation.
The page field stays /home/register across account/withdrawal/deposit/agent actions, so it cannot classify feature exclusivity by itself.
blocked=false reports debugger-rule evaluation before the separate existing AdResources filter and cannot demonstrate that seeded ad blocking failed.
Performance method * is unknown, not evidence that every HTTP verb was used.
